21.q_text: E หมายเหตุ : อันนี้เราหา reference แบบฟันธงเป๊ะๆไปเลยยังไม่ได้ ส่วนใหญ่จะบอกคล้ายๆกันว่ากลุ่ม azo group สามารถทำให้ เกิดสีได้ อันนี้เป็นข้อมูลที่มาจาก wikipidia อ่ะ ถ้าหาอันที่ชัดเจนและชัวร์กว่านี้แล้วจะแก้ไขมาให้ใหม่ “As a consequence of п-delocalization, aryl azo compounds have vivid colors, especially reds, oranges, and yellows. Therefore, they are used as dyes, and are commonly known as azo dyes, an example of which is Disperse Orange 1. Some azo compounds, eg. methyl orange, are used as acid-base indicators due to the different colors of their acid and salt forms. The development of azo dyes was an important step in the development of the chemical industry. Azo pigments are colorless particles (typically earths or clays), which have been colored using an azo compound. Azo pigments are important in a variety of paints including artist's paints. They have excellent coloring properties, again mainly in the yellow to red range, as well as lightfastness. The lightfastness depends not only on the properties of the organic azo compound, but also on the way they have been adsorbed on the pigment carrier.
